snippet.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

Coming to Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on February 16, 2027. Available for pre-order!

Follow the official SaGa social channels:
